name: p01-model-declared
open_question: Should a checker report how strongly a record shows which model produced it, derived from what is attached rather than from what the writer says?
description: A model decision that names its model only in actor.model, with nothing attached about the model.

expected_under_02.rests_on: Sections 2.2 (actor), 4.2 (a statement by the issuer alone can be reported but cannot make a step pass)

proposed: Same state. The report adds: model binding 'declared' -- the writer's statement only, nothing attached shows it. The record carries no new member; the strength is derived by the checker.
status: PROPOSAL: not draft text. For discussion at IETF 127.
